## About

{{ config('settings.site_name', 'IPTV Service') }} is a premium IPTV streaming platform that provides access to thousands of live TV channels, movies, TV series, and sports events from every corner of the world. We offer high-quality streaming with support for multiple devices and competitive pricing plans.

## Services

- **Live TV Channels**: Thousands of channels from countries worldwide including entertainment, news, sports, kids, documentary, music, and more
- **Video on Demand (VOD)**: Extensive library of movies and TV series updated regularly
- **Sports Streaming**: Live sports events including football, basketball, tennis, MMA, boxing, and more
- **Multi-Device Support**: Compatible with Smart TVs, Android, iOS, Windows, Mac, Firestick, MAG boxes, and more
- **EPG (Electronic Program Guide)**: Full TV guide for easy channel navigation
- **HD & 4K Quality**: High-definition and ultra-high-definition streaming quality
- **Anti-Freeze Technology**: Stable and reliable streaming with minimal buffering

## Pricing

We offer flexible subscription plans to suit every budget. Plans include options for different connection counts and durations. All plans include full access to live channels, VOD content, sports, and EPG guide. Visit our pricing page for current rates and special offers.

## Device Compatibility

Our service works on a wide range of devices:
- Smart TVs (Samsung, LG, Sony, etc.)
- Android devices (phones, tablets, TV boxes)
- iOS devices (iPhone, iPad)
- Amazon Firestick & Fire TV
- Windows & Mac computers
- MAG boxes
- Formuler devices
- Enigma2/Dreambox
- VLC Media Player
- Any IPTV-compatible player

We offer a free trial so you can test our service before committing to a subscription. Visit /trial to request your free trial.
